primitives.name: Territorial Play Alignment
primitives.verbatim_quote: Play your territory as long as the receiver is in it.
primitives.assumptions: Receiver motion is bounded within a defined spatial region; defender maintains positional alignment.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When receiver exits territorial bounds or ball is intercepted.

layer2.mapping: Defender's coverage set is isomorphic to receiver's reachable space under time constraint.
layer2.telemetry: Coverage area overlap ratio between defender and receiver.

primitives.name: Receiver Coverage Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: Cover the receiver in any territory in which he is uncovered.
primitives.assumptions: Coverage is deterministic when receiver is in uncovered space.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When receiver enters covered region or ball is thrown.

layer2.mapping: Coverage kernel derived from defender's proximity to uncovered receiver region.
layer2.telemetry: Probability of successful coverage given receiver velocity and defender speed.

primitives.name: Ball Catch Decision Threshold
primitives.verbatim_quote: Catch the ball if you can; beat it down, at least.
primitives.assumptions: Catchability depends on ball speed and receiver agility; gain is measured post-catch.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When ball trajectory intersects ground before receiver reach.

layer2.mapping: Catch decision modeled as binary outcome based on kinematic feasibility.
layer2.telemetry: Success rate of catch attempts under varying ball speeds.

primitives.name: Fourth Down Tactical Threshold
primitives.verbatim_quote: If ball is sure to strike ground, don't catch it on fourth down unless you can make a long gain.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F': 'fourth down flag (boolean)', 'G': 'gain threshold (m)', 'P': 'probability of ground impact (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Risk-reward trade-off is quantifiable; gain must exceed threshold to justify risk.

layer2.mapping: Decision kernel derived from probabilistic gain estimation under ground impact.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of non-catch decisions on fourth down with high ground impact.
